pr_title: Add system data streams to feature state snapshots
pr_body:
This PR adds system data streams to the "snapshot feature state" code block, so that if we're snapshotting a feature by name we grab that feature's system data streams too.

Fixes #75860

issue_context.title: Include system data streams when snapshotting feature states
issue_context.body:
In the course of work on #75819, we discovered that we have not connected system data streams and snapshots. If a user creates a snapshot for a specific set of indices and the Fleet feature state, the fleet data stream and backing indices will not be included. This is a bug, though at the moment it only affects Fleet. (A general snapshot and restore of the cluster will include all feature states.)

We need to add system data stream handling to the snapshot and restore code for feature states.

review_comments: Just re-reading this PR I noticed: Are we guaranteed to have the feature `name` available? If we don't have the right plugins active at restore time we'll just NPE here won't we?
That's a great catch. Thank you!
Added a comment to the linked issue so we remember to clean up the places we have to work around this in tests. No action required here, just noting.
